$comment: Medical sign-off ledger for /concerns/*. A slug appears under `signed` ONLY when the named doctor has actually read that page and told us so — it is not the same thing as `reviewedBy` in content/data/concerns.ts, which is an intended reviewer. An absent slug means unsigned: the page renders 'Awaiting medical review' in place of the reviewer byline, its schema asserts no reviewer and no lastReviewed, and `pnpm validate:concerns` warns. To sign one off, add "<concern-slug>": { "doctor": "<slug from content/data/doctors.ts>", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD" }.
